title: Recording: Drumming Is My Madness, You Can’t Fight Lightning by Ringo Starr | 1980
content:
Compass Point Studios, New Providence, Bahamas
Producer: Ringo Starr

Ringo Starr worked on two songs for his eighth studio album, Stop And Smell The Roses, on 1 December 1980.

‘Drumming Is My Madness’ was written by Harry Nilsson, who had collaborated with Starr since 1973’s Ringo. The backing track had been recorded on 4 November, and the song was completed with more overdubs on 2, 3, and 4 December.

The other song worked on was the outtake ‘You Can’t Fight Lightning’, which had been recorded with Paul and Linda McCartney in France in July 1980.
